title: Activity Diagram — Handle Late Arrival
preconditions: 2. Assigned ArrivalGroup window ended without valid normal check-in.
3. Appointment is the relevant booking context.

nodes.label: Staff identifies Patient arriving after assigned ArrivalGroup window
Do not reopen VisitInstance; require documented reschedule / new operational arrangement
Which real operational outcome is chosen?
Accept Patient manually while keeping original Appointment and ArrivalGroup
Register check-in / actual arrival and mark late accepted arrival
Create/activate QueueEntry and set manualHandling flag
Exclude from automatic numeric queue position; make no priority promise
Call Patient when operationally appropriate without consuming another group capacity
Reschedule after Patient agreement using same-service / same-terms atomic rules
Record terminal NO_SHOW and apply saved no-show financial policy
Record NOT_COMPLETED when Patient arrived but service was not completed

edges.meaning: Use AD-09 invariants; secure new capacity first

binding_business_rules: No automatic move to a later group.
No capacity consumption from another ArrivalGroup for manual acceptance.
explicitly_forbidden: LATE / LATE_ACCEPTED as a new Visit/Queue state.
qa_gates: 1. Verify the exact Use Case title and scope.
2. Verify the Initial Node exists and has no incoming flow.
3. Verify the Activity Final exists and has no outgoing flow.
4. Verify every Action is source-supported and verb-led.
5. Verify every Decision has meaningful guarded outgoing flows.
6. Verify every Merge is used only to reunite alternatives, not as decoration.
7. Verify Fork/Join is absent unless true parallelism is explicitly required.
8. Verify all arrows are Control Flows unless an Object Flow is explicitly specified.
10. Verify no Sequence lifeline/message notation appears.
11. Verify actor permissions and product boundaries.
12. Verify independent lifecycle states are not collapsed into one generic status.
13. Verify all rendered branch guards are mutually understandable and not contradictory.
14. Render SVG/PNG/PDF; open every actual output and inspect it visually.
15. Compare the render against this MD item-by-item and correct semantic, notation, routing, and readability issues.
